stem: A long metal strip is $6$ cm wide. It is bent along two lines parallel to its length to form a gutter with an isosceles trapezium cross section. The horizontal base is $2$ cm wide and each sloping side is $2$ cm wide. Each side makes an angle $\theta$ with the outward horizontal, where $0<\theta<\pi/2$. The cross-sectional area is $A$ cm$^2$. Let $x=\cos\theta$.

parts.text: Show that $A=4(1+\cos\theta)\sin\theta$.

scheme.text: 上底长 $2+4\cos\theta$，高 $2\sin\theta$。梯形面积为 $\tfrac12[2+(2+4\cos\theta)]\cdot2\sin\theta$。
$A=4(1+\cos\theta)\sin\theta$。

parts.approach: 先由斜边的水平、竖直投影求出梯形上底与高度，再使用梯形面积公式。

parts.text: Show that $A^2=16(1+2x-2x^3-x^4)$ and state the range of $x$.
parts.approach: 面积平方后，用余弦代换与正余弦平方恒等式消去正弦，再展开成多项式；角度范围给新变量范围。
